headlines.title: Union Pacific (UNP) CFO Jennifer Hamann To Retire After 35 Years
headlines.summary: Union Pacific (NYSE:UNP) said longtime Chief Financial Officer Jennifer Hamann will retire after a 35-year career at the railroad. Hamann, who has held the CFO role through the pandemic period and recent restructuring efforts, plans to step down from the finance post. The company highlighted her involvement in past capital allocation decisions as Union Pacific works through a proposed merger and operational milestones.

headlines.title: How Will Union Pacific Stock React To Its Upcoming Earnings?
headlines.summary: Union Pacific (NYSE:UNP) is scheduled to report its earnings on Thursday, October 22, 2026. The company has a market value of about $170.7 billion. Over the last twelve months it generated $25.4 billion in revenue and $10.2 billion in operating profit, with net income of $7.3 billion.

description: Union Pacific Corporation, through its subsidiary, Union Pacific Railroad Company, operates in the railroad business in the United States. It offers transportation services for grain and grain products, fertilizers, food and refrigerated products, and coal and renewables to grain processors, animal feeders, and ethanol and renewable biofuel producers; and construction products, industrial chemicals, plastics, forest products, specialized products, metals and ores, petroleum, liquid petroleum gases, soda ash, and sand, as well as finished automobiles, automotive parts, and merchandise in intermodal containers. The company was founded in 1862 and is headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska.
